I went to Mindspace Psychology Center on May 7 for an ADHD assessment and diagnosis, but unfortunately the experience left me feeling confused and disappointed.

Before the appointment, I informed the admin that I was specifically seeking an official ADHD diagnosis to better understand my condition and what support I may need. I also completed ADHD questionnaires beforehand, but these were never discussed during the consultation and it honestly felt like the information had not been communicated to the psychiatrist at all.

The overall experience felt very unclear and unstructured. There was little guidance upon arrival, no introduction or explanation of the assessment process, and during the consultation I often felt like I had to lead the conversation myself rather than being properly evaluated. At multiple points I was genuinely unsure whether I was actually being assessed or if we were just casually talking.

What disappointed me most was leaving without any formal assessment conclusion, diagnosis summary, or medical documentation. For the price paid, I expected a much more professional and thorough experience. To be honest, I left feeling like even a psychology student friend of mine could have provided more direction and structure than what I received during this appointment.

I booked this appointment hoping for clarity and professional support, so the experience was really discouraging.

The location is easily accessible and there is parking available. The clinic's atmosphere is very pleasant, and the staff are knowledgeable, experienced, and provide excellent advice. You can inquire about the service fees before deciding to use their services.
